```{r Landed weight correction}
# Kind of looks like sometimes 'landed weight' is 'live weight' and vice versa. Fix this.

Landings_GoC_Cleaned_wSp$weight_kg_corrected <- ifelse(
  Landings_GoC_Cleaned_wSp$live_weight >= Landings_GoC_Cleaned_wSp$landed_weight,
  Landings_GoC_Cleaned_wSp$live_weight,
  Landings_GoC_Cleaned_wSp$landed_weight
)
```

```{r How many records are appended with information about species, genus, family?}
Landings_GoC_Cleaned_wSp %>%
  pull(estimated_species_name) %>%
  {c(n_na = sum(is.na(.)),
      n_unknown = sum(. == "unknown", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_NEI = sum(. == "NEI", na.rm = TRUE)
    ) }
# 1008085 (4186 + 210708 + 793191) out of 3716415 records (27%) for species are NA, "unknown", or "NEI"
# Meaning we have species info for 73% of records.

Landings_GoC_Cleaned_wSp %>%
  pull(estimated_genus_name) %>%
  {c(n_na = sum(is.na(.)),
     n_unknown = sum(. == "unknown", na.rm = TRUE),
     n_NEI = sum(. == "NEI", na.rm = TRUE)
    ) }
# 1008085 (214894 + 0 + 793191) out of 3716415 records (27%) for genus are NA, "unknown", or "NEI"
# Meaning we have genus info for 73% of records.

Landings_GoC_Cleaned_wSp %>%
  pull(estimated_family_name) %>%
  {c(n_na = sum(is.na(.)),
     n_unknown = sum(. == "unknown", na.rm = TRUE),
     n_NEI = sum(. == "NEI", na.rm = TRUE),
     n_family_info_pending = sum(. == "family missing but genus available", na.rm = TRUE)
    ) }
# 352911 (192402 + 0 + 160509) out of 3716415 records (9%) for family are NA, "unknown", or "NEI". 29659 records have information about genus but family info pending.
# Meaning we already have or can get family info for 91% of records.
```

GoC_Landings_for_CPUE<- Landings_GoC_Cleaned_wSp
# 3716415 obs., 43 vars.

# Calculate the difference in days between period start and end:

GoC_Landings_for_CPUE<- GoC_Landings_for_CPUE %>%
  filter(!is.na(days_fishing) & days_fishing > 0 & live_weight > 0) %>%
  mutate(CPUE_kg.day = weight_kg_corrected / days_fishing)

```{r Estimate CPUE for each taxonomic group per region per year versus "historic" baseline}
# STEP 1: ESTABLISH CPUE BASELINE VALUES -----
# where baseline equals CPUE average from 2005-2015
CPUE_baseline <- GoC_Landings_for_CPUE %>%
  filter(year >= 2005, year <= 2015) %>%
  group_by(OHI_Region_No, IHH_functional_major_groups_sm) %>%
  summarise(
    CPUE_baseline = mean(CPUE_kg.day, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# STEP 2:CALCULATE CPUE VALUES FOR RECENT YEARS -----
CPUE_recent <- GoC_Landings_for_CPUE %>%
  filter(year >= 2016, year <= 2024) %>%
  group_by(year, OHI_Region_No, IHH_functional_major_groups_sm) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Biomass_kg = sum(weight_kg_corrected, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_Value_mxn = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_Days = sum(days_fishing, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_CPUE = mean(CPUE_kg.day, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_records = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# STEP 3: COMPUTE PERCENT BIOMASS FOR RECENT YEARS -----
CPUE_recent <- CPUE_recent %>%
  group_by(year, OHI_Region_No) %>%
  mutate(
    total_biomass_state_year = sum(Total_Biomass_kg, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_of_total_biomass = (Total_Biomass_kg / total_biomass_state_year) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# STEP 4: MERGE BASELINE TO PRESENT DATA -----
CPUE_Table <- CPUE_recent %>%
  left_join(CPUE_baseline,
            by = c("OHI_Region_No", "IHH_functional_major_groups_sm")) %>%
  mutate(
    CPUE_ratio = Avg_CPUE / CPUE_baseline  # Score = CPUEpresent / CPUE_baseline
  )

# STEP 5: DESIRED TABLE -----
CPUE_Table <- CPUE_Table %>%
  transmute(
    OHI_Region = OHI_Region_No,
    Year = year,
    IHH_Taxonomic_Group = IHH_functional_major_groups_sm,
    CPUEpresent_vs_CPUEbaseline = round(CPUE_ratio, 3),
    Total_Landings_kg = round(Total_Biomass_kg, 1),
    Taxa_per_Total_Catch = round(pct_of_total_biomass, 2)
  ) %>%
  arrange(OHI_Region, Year, IHH_Taxonomic_Group)

# STEP 6: OHI SCORES PER REGION PER YEAR -----
OHI_CPUE_Scores <- CPUE_Table %>%
  mutate(TaxaProp = Taxa_per_Total_Catch/100) %>%     # IF your % values are 0–100; if 0–1 then skip this line
  group_by(Year, OHI_Region) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_relative.CPUE_AllGroups = sum(CPUEpresent_vs_CPUEbaseline * TaxaProp, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r Save this CPUE data table}
write.csv(OHI_CPUE_Scores, "/home/ferrer/ohi_goc_prep/FP/FIS/OHI_CPUEScores_UNDERCONSTRUCTION_Dec022025.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

## Testing the effect of subsidy removal on Biomass & CPUE
```{r Testing the effect of subsidy removal on Biomass & CPUE}
CPUE_summary <- CPUE_summary %>%
  mutate(
    subsidy_period = case_when(
      year < 2018 ~ "pre",
      year > 2019 ~ "post",
      TRUE ~ "in between"
    )
  )

CPUE_Landings_filtered2 <- CPUE_Landings_filtered %>%
  filter(year >= 2014 & year < 2025) %>%
  mutate(
    subsidy_period = case_when(
      year < 2018 ~ "pre",
      year > 2019 ~ "post",
      TRUE ~ "in between"
    )
  )

CPUE_Landings_filtered2 %>%
  distinct(year, subsidy_period)
# looks good, four years on either side

## Mixed-effects linear model
library(Matrix)
library(lattice)
# library(lme4) # does not work
library(nlme)
library(sjPlot)

CPUE_Landings_filtered2$main_species_group <- factor(CPUE_Landings_filtered2$main_species_group)

Biomass.SubsidyTest_mixedLM <- lme(
  log10(weight_kg_corrected) ~ subsidy_period,       # fixed effect
  random = ~1 | main_species_group/state,  # nested random intercept
  data = CPUE_Landings_filtered2
)

summary(Biomass.SubsidyTest_mixedLM)

CPUE.SubsidyTest_mixedLM <- lme(
  # fixed effects of subsidy period and time
  CPUE_kg.day ~ subsidy_period + year,
  data = CPUE_Landings_filtered2,
  random = list(
    state = pdSymm(~ 1),   # random intercept + slope for year by state
    main_species_group  = pdDiag(~ 1)       # random intercept for taxa
  )
)

summary(CPUE.SubsidyTest_mixedLM)
```

```{r Catch compare to CNP}
options(scipen = 999) # Force same numeric format; don't want scientific notation

# Setting up the dataframe to compare to the C.N.P.
CPUE_Landings_summarized <- CPUE_Landings_filtered %>%
  filter(year %in% 2020:2024) %>%
  select(state, main_species_group, year, CPUE_kg.day, weight_kg_corrected) %>%
  group_by(state, main_species_group) %>%
  summarize(
    # First sum per year, then average across years 2020–2022
    Baseline_Total_Catch_2020_2022 = mean(
      tapply(weight_kg_corrected[year %in% 2020:2022],
             year[year %in% 2020:2022],
             sum, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    Total_Catch_2023 = sum(weight_kg_corrected[year == 2023], na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_Catch_2024 = sum(weight_kg_corrected[year == 2024], na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_CPUE_2020_2022 = mean(CPUE_kg.day[year %in% 2020:2022], na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_CPUE_2023 = mean(CPUE_kg.day[year == 2023], na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_CPUE_2024 = mean(CPUE_kg.day[year == 2024], na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    # Define a threshold for suspiciously high values
    qc_flag = Baseline_Total_Catch_2020_2022 * 3,
    # Define a 30% margin of error around the baseline mean - SUBSTANTIALLY different
    lowest_bound = Baseline_Total_Catch_2020_2022 * 0.70, # most extreme cases must come first
    highest_bound = Baseline_Total_Catch_2020_2022 * 1.30,
    # Define a 5% margin of error around the baseline mean
    low_bound = Baseline_Total_Catch_2020_2022 * 0.95,
    high_bound = Baseline_Total_Catch_2020_2022 * 1.05,

    # 2023 comparison with margin of error
    CatchCompare_2023_vs_Baseline = case_when(
      Total_Catch_2023 > qc_flag ~ "qc flag: > 3x higher",
      Total_Catch_2023 > highest_bound ~ "substantially higher",
      Total_Catch_2023 < lowest_bound ~ "substantially lower",
      Total_Catch_2023 > high_bound ~ "higher",
      Total_Catch_2023 < low_bound ~ "lower",
      TRUE ~ "similar"
    ),

    # 2024 comparison with margin of error
    CatchCompare_2024_vs_Baseline = case_when(
      Total_Catch_2024 > qc_flag ~ "qc flag: > 3x higher",
      Total_Catch_2024 > highest_bound ~ "substantially higher",
      Total_Catch_2024 < lowest_bound ~ "substantially lower",
      Total_Catch_2024 > high_bound ~ "higher",
      Total_Catch_2024 < low_bound ~ "lower",
      TRUE ~ "similar"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-low_bound, -high_bound, -lowest_bound, -highest_bound, -qc_flag)   # remove helper columns if not needed

# Add & re-arrange columns:
CPUE_Landings_summarized$CNP_Recommendation<- NA

CPUE_Landings_summarized <- CPUE_Landings_summarized %>%
  select(state,
         main_species_group,
         CNP_Recommendation,
         Baseline_Total_Catch_2020_2022,
         Total_Catch_2023,
         CatchCompare_2023_vs_Baseline,
         Total_Catch_2024,
         CatchCompare_2024_vs_Baseline,
         Avg_CPUE_2020_2022,
         Avg_CPUE_2023,
         Avg_CPUE_2024,
         everything())  # keeps any other columns after
```
